excerpt: Assess Ras Al Khaimah's 2027 investment outlook using the latest available transaction, tourism and project evidence with clear forecast limitations.
introduction:
Ras Al Khaimah's 2027 property outlook depends on tourism, residential demand, new supply and the timing of individual projects. The latest official transaction breakdown found for this guide covers the first half of 2026. It provides market context for assessing supply, demand and the cost of individual properties.

Compare the exact unit, ownership right, full cost and competing supply. Update the evidence as newer figures and project announcements become available.
takeaways: The H1 2026 AED 2.89 billion total includes sales, mortgages and waivers, not sales alone.
Wynn's September 2027 opening is a company expectation as of 5 November 2026, not a completed event.
Test rent, vacancy, delivery and resale scenarios for the individual property.

sections.heading: What do the latest official transaction figures show?
sections.body:
[Emirates News Agency reported](https://www.wam.ae/en/article/c1p3sd1-ras-khaimah-real-estate-transactions-reach-aed289) that Ras Al Khaimah Municipality recorded around AED 2.89 billion of real estate transactions in January–June 2026. The total includes approximately AED 1.353 billion of sales, AED 1.160 billion of mortgages and AED 380 million of waivers. These are mixed transaction types, not apartment sales alone.

The chart shows the reported components, rounded as published. Their approximate sum can differ slightly from the headline because of rounding. The figures do not establish a price per unit, a rental yield or what will happen in 2027.

[CBRE's H1 2026 Ras Al Khaimah review](https://www.cbre.ae/press-releases/rak-real-estate-market-review-h1-2026) offers a separate residential market perspective. Check its methodology and period before comparing it with government transaction totals.

[Gulf Business summarised CBRE’s H1 2026 review](https://gulfbusiness.com/en/2026/real-estate/rak-apartment-prices-rise-18-as-luxury-demand-grows/).

sections.heading: How might tourism and projects matter?
sections.body:
[Ras Al Khaimah Tourism Development Authority](https://raktda.com/press-release-ras-al-khaimah-welcomes-record-visitors-in-first-half-of-2026-as-landmark-developments-advance/) reported more than 670,000 visitors in H1 2026. Visitor arrivals are not the occupancy rate or income of a particular apartment. Check the intended rental use and current permit requirements before modelling short stays.

In its [5 November 2026 Q3 filing](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1174922/000117492226000078/ex991wrlq32026pressrelease.htm), Wynn Resorts said Wynn Al Marjan Island was planned to open in September 2027. That is a forward-looking company statement, not a completed opening or a promise of property appreciation.

Infrastructure and tourism can affect demand, but the timing, location and scale of the effect on a specific home remain uncertain.

[Gulf News also reported the authority’s H1 2026 visitor figures](https://gulfnews.com/business/tourism/ras-al-khaimah-welcomes-record-670000-visitors-in-h1-2026-domestic-arrivals-jump-47-1.500618577).

sections.heading: Check supply and the building
sections.body:
List nearby ready and scheduled properties that could compete for the same tenants. A handover schedule can move and does not establish that all units will be vacant at once. Ask for current project registration, construction evidence and the contracted completion provisions.

Inspect the actual building or signed specification, parking, access, service charges and management arrangements. A waterfront location does not guarantee a particular view, private beach access or a lower maintenance cost. The [Ras Al Khaimah lifestyle guide](/journal/ras-al-khaimah-property-lifestyle) provides location context.

For a ready unit, review title, seller authority, any mortgage or tenancy and outstanding charges. Obtain a qualified inspection where necessary.

sections.heading: Verify ownership and total cost
sections.body:
RAK Municipality's [real estate sale service](https://sanad.mun.rak.ae/docs/en/services-card-arabic-temp-28) lists designated freehold areas and the sale registration process. Confirm the buyer's right for the exact property and obtain a current itemised fee quote. Do not assume every property in the emirate has the same ownership status.

Add the price, buyer-paid registration, brokerage, finance, initial work and furnishing. Request the service-charge statement or the basis of an estimate for a new building. Keep a separate reserve for repairs and vacancy.

For off-plan, verify the developer, registered project, payment recipient, contract and handover provisions with the municipality and relevant parties. Review the payment schedule alongside the contract’s delivery terms and the property’s costs.

sections.heading: Build scenarios for 2027
sections.body:
A stronger scenario may involve timely project delivery and sufficient tenant demand; a weaker one may involve delayed handover, competing supply or longer vacancy. These are planning possibilities, not predictions or probabilities. Use comparable signed leases and deduct vacancy, charges, management, repairs and insurance.

Test a lower rent, higher cost and a sale price below the purchase price. Keep financing and selling costs separate from net operating yield. If the investment is affordable only after a particular 2027 event or price increase, revisit the budget.

Ask about the current rules for short-term accommodation if that is the intended strategy. A tourism headline is not a permit or an operating plan.

sections.heading: Review the evidence regularly
sections.body:
Record the publication date, measurement period and definition for each source. Monitor actual project completion, signed leases and comparable completed sales where available. A scheduled opening or handover can change and should not be treated as an observed result.

If comparable evidence is thin, show a range and seek an appropriate professional valuation. Refresh this 2027 outlook before publication or purchase and whenever a material project milestone changes.

sections.heading: Compare the cost of holding the property
sections.body:
Request the current service-charge statement, insurance information and any maintenance history for a ready unit. For an unfinished project, ask whether the estimated charge is approved or provisional and when a final budget will be available. Include utilities paid during a vacancy and the cost of managing the tenancy.

For a waterfront home, inspect windows, balcony and exposed fittings and seek qualified advice if you identify a concern. Review maintenance history and insurance terms for the specific coastal building. Recalculate the investment if a written quote changes a material assumption.

sections.heading: Request current RAK options
sections.body:
Browse the [Aliyas Ras Al Khaimah project collection](/projects?emirate=Ras%20Al%20Khaimah) and [contact Aliyas](/contact) with your budget and intended use. Ask which exact units are currently available and request their plans, terms and documents.

Verify ownership and current official costs before committing.
